newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola sees Q3 EPS $0.38-$0.39 - analyst.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola sees Q3 EPS $0.38-$0.39 - analyst.

text.p: Coca-Cola Co told analysts on Tuesday that it expects to earn $0.38-$0.39 per share in the third quarter, according to one analyst.

The company told analysts it will have operating earnings of $0.37 per share, and after accounting for various unusual charges and gains, will have a net gain of $0.01 to $0.02 per share, according to Roy Burry, an analyst at Oppenheimer & Co.
Burry said he was maintaining his neutral rating on the stock.
Burry said the company mentioned five negative items, including a loss of shipments because of bottler inventory reductions that will result in a charge of $180-$200 million.
The company said earlier it was taking the provision for "structural changes."
Other negative items included system improvements, manufacturing efficiency improvements and a doubling in contributions to its charitable foundation, Burry said.
The two positive provisions came from a settlement with the Internal Revenue Service and the sales of rights to buy shares in bottlers, he said.
According to Burry, the company reported that gallon sales were flat for the quarter.
